en.已找到 TeslaCam，尚未发现可归档的录像。: TeslaCam exists. No clips are ready to archive.
en.镜像内还没有 TeslaCam 目录。: No TeslaCam folder on the USB image.
en.片段需要连续两次扫描保持稳定后才会入库。: A clip must be stable across two scans before it is archived.
en.镜像最近有写入，可能正在录制或更新文件，等待下一次扫描。: The USB image was written to recently. Waiting for the next scan.
en.当前镜像已完成扫描。: The current USB image has been scanned.
en.另一个任务正在使用虚拟 U 盘，同步稍后继续。: Another task is using the virtual USB drive.
en.恢复车机导出后继续同步。: Restore the USB connection to resume syncing.
en.同步进程没有按时报告扫描状态，请查看设备日志。: Sync has not reported back. Check the device logs.
en.低码率画面不可用，可手动切换原画: Lower quality unavailable. Select Original to retry.
en.此片段没有行车数据: No driving data in this clip
en.App Secret (已保存则留空表示不修改): App Secret (leave blank to keep current)
en.上传 CSS 皮肤文件或背景图 (jpg/png/webp)。CSS 中引用图片: Upload a CSS skin file or background image (jpg/png/webp). Reference images in CSS as /skin-media/filename.
en.升级会从 GitHub 及多个镜像并发竞速拉取最新程序, 覆盖本机文件并自动重启: The upgrade fetches the latest build from GitHub and multiple mirrors in parallel, overwrites local files and restarts the service automatically (about 5 s); configs, recordings and login info are unaffected.
en.半透明单行: 时间/位置/车速/挡位/油门/刹车, 基本不挡画面: Single semi-transparent line: time/location/speed/gear/throttle/brake, barely covers the view
en.单选取原文件直接下载(加水印时走本机合成)；多选合成一个多画面视频。下载/打包按: Single-select downloads the original file directly (with watermark it composites locally); multi-select merges one multi-view video. Downloads/zips export at the selected quality (first time may wait for transcoding).
en.哨兵触发时把时间/位置/触发原因和触发画面推到飞书。默认走自建应用私聊(只有你本: When Sentry triggers, pushes time/location, trigger reason and the trigger frame to Feishu. Defaults to private messages via your own app (only you can see them); you can also switch to a group bot webhook (visible to the whole group). Video push works for private messages only.
en.尝试次数过多，请 5 分钟后再试: Too many attempts, try again in 5 minutes
en.已加入队列, 归档同步时写入车机U盘: Queued, will be written to car USB during archive sync
en.换个日期或点「全部」查看本分类所有事件: Try another date or tap "All" to see all events in this category
en.接收人: 你的 open_id (ou_ 开头) 或飞书登录邮箱: Recipient: your open_id (starts with ou_) or Feishu login email
en.推送内容：封面卡片（触发那帧图 + 信息，最快）: Push content: cover card (trigger frame + info, fastest)
en.改完本机会自动用新密码重新登录，手机/其它设备上的登录状态立即失效。: After the change, this device logs back in with the new password automatically; login sessions on phones/other devices are invalidated immediately.
en.敏感信息已明文显示，注意别外发: Sensitive info shown in plain text, be careful when sharing
en.暂无皮肤, 使用默认外观: No skins, using the default look
en.浏览和管理车机U盘 (特斯拉写入的镜像)。连接后会临时断开车机读取几秒，5 分钟: Browse and manage the car USB drive (the mirror written by Tesla). Connecting briefly interrupts car read access for a few seconds; it auto-restores after 5 minutes of inactivity.
en.界面语言，保存在本机浏览器: UI language, saved in this browser
en.确定要退出登录吗？: Are you sure you want to log out?
en.私聊推送 — 只有我本人能看到: Direct message — only I can see it
en.秒 (等片段写完再推): seconds (wait for clips to finish writing)
en.群机器人 — 群里所有人都能看到: Group bot — everyone in the group can see it
en.设备正在拼接各路画面, 请勿关闭页面: Stitching camera views, do not close this page
en.车机录制后, 归档同步任务会自动把视频收进来 (镜像需空闲10分钟): After the car records, archive sync pulls in videos automatically (mirror needs 10 min idle)
en.车机要求单个音频 <1MB, 请裁剪后重试: Car requires each audio file <1MB, trim it and retry
en.锁车音必须是 WAV (mp3 只能当喇叭音效): Lock chime must be WAV (mp3 only works as a Boombox sound)
en.锁车音要求 WAV 44.1kHz 16-bit <1MB 1~5秒；LockC: Lock chime requires WAV 44.1kHz 16-bit <1MB 1–5 s; LockChime.wav goes to the root of the car USB drive, other mp3/wav files are written to the Boombox/ folder as Boombox sounds. Files are written to the car USB during archive sync.
en.＋ 上传文件到当前目录 (任意类型, ≤100MB): ＋ Upload file to current folder (any type, ≤100MB)
en.已启用私聊推送, 等下一个哨兵事件: Direct messages enabled, waiting for the next Sentry event
en.已启用, 但接收人/应用凭据未配全: Enabled, but recipient/app credentials are incomplete
en.私聊需要 App ID / Secret + 接收人: Direct messages need App ID / Secret + recipient
en.请先填群机器人 webhook: Fill in the group bot webhook first
en.当前未开启登录保护, 设置密码后即开启: Login protection is off, set a password to enable it
en.新密码至少 6 位: New password must be at least 6 characters
en.密码已更新, 其它设备需要重新登录: Password updated, other devices need to sign in again
en.车机U盘已连接 (已临时断开车机读取, 5分钟无操作自动恢复): Car USB drive connected (car access temporarily released, auto-restores after 5 minutes idle)
en.车机U盘未连接, 请先点「连接车机U盘」: Car USB drive not connected, tap 「Connect car USB drive」 first
en.归档里没有可用的片段: No usable clips in the archive
en.已有合成在进行: A merge is already in progress
en.此浏览器不支持本机合成, 请使用打包下载: This browser does not support local merging, use the packaged download
en.按时间与触发原因浏览，同步回放每个视角。: Browse by time and event, then replay every angle.
en.你可以稍后回来，或查看同步服务状态。: Check back later or review the sync service status.
en.上传背景图片或自己的 CSS 皮肤。: Upload a background image or your own CSS theme.
en.上传喜欢的声音，自动转换为车机锁车音效。: Upload audio and convert it into a vehicle lock sound.
en.为车机上的车辆可视化换一套外观。: Give the on-screen vehicle a new look.
en.浏览设备归档，或连接车机 U 盘管理文件。: Browse the archive or connect the vehicle drive to manage files.
en.把新的哨兵事件送到你的 QQ 或飞书。: Send new Sentry events to QQ or Feishu.
en.管理用于访问此设备的登录凭据。: Manage the credentials used to access this device.
en.界面语言保存在当前浏览器中。: The display language is saved in this browser.
en.显示最近已完成同步的录像片段: The latest completed recording to sync
en.连接后车机读写会暂停，请在停车后操作。: Connecting pauses vehicle access. Do this while parked.
en.图片将直接写入 Wraps 目录，完成后请恢复车机导出。: Images are written to Wraps. Restore vehicle access when done.
en.网页改动会写入车机 U 盘，操作完成后请恢复导出。: Changes write to the vehicle drive. Restore vehicle access when done.
en.闲置后系统会尝试自动恢复导出: Vehicle access also restores after inactivity
en.登录以查看你的行车记录。: Sign in to your recording library.
en.多路回放 · 事件归档 · 本地存储: Multi-camera replay · Event archive · Local storage
en.你的录像，留在你的设备上。: Your recordings stay on your device.
en.更新 ZIP 为空或超过 16 MiB: The ZIP is empty or exceeds 16 MiB.
en.SHA-256 须为 64 位十六进制，也可留空: Enter 64 hexadecimal characters for SHA-256, or leave it blank.
en.正在上传并安装 ZIP，请保持页面打开…: Uploading and installing the ZIP. Keep this page open…
en.可粘贴打包脚本生成的 64 位校验值: Optional 64-character checksum from the packaging script
en.请选择本项目打包的更新 ZIP，版本需高于当前版本。校验通过后会重启服务，配置、: Choose an update ZIP built for this project. Its version must be newer. The service restarts after validation and keeps your settings, recordings and account data.
en.管理车机 U 盘时会暂停车机读写。完成操作后请恢复导出；5 分钟无操作也会尝试自: Drive management pauses vehicle access. Restore access when finished; restoration is also attempted after 5 minutes of inactivity.
en.主机锁定了车机 U 盘，请在主机端弹出后重试: The host locked the USB drive. Eject it from the host and try again.
en.车机 U 盘仍有写入，请暂停录制后重试: The USB drive is still being written to. Pause recording and try again.
en.保存多个音效，停车后选择要写入车机的一段。: Save several lock sounds, then choose one to apply while parked.
en.支持 WAV、MP3、M4A、AAC、FLAC、OGG、OPUS 和 WEBM，: Upload a WAV, MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, or WEBM file up to 20 MB. Audio is trimmed and converted to WAV.
en.＋ 上传并转换锁车音: ＋ Upload and convert a lock sound
en.已写入车机 U 盘: Written to the vehicle USB drive
en.请停车后写入。写入时将短暂暂停车机 U 盘。: Park before applying. The vehicle USB drive will briefly disconnect.
en.正在写入车机 U 盘…: Writing to the vehicle USB drive…
en.读取音效库失败，请重新打开此页。: Could not read the sound library. Reopen this page.
en.连接中断，重新打开音效库可查看写入结果。: Connection lost. Reopen the sound library to check the result.
en.正在上传并转换锁车音…: Uploading and converting the lock sound…
en.正在恢复车机导出…: Restoring USB access for the vehicle…
en.上传的音效保存在 F50 音效库。点击「设为锁车音」后，所选音效才会写入 U 盘: Uploads stay in the F50 sound library. Choose Set as lock chime to write the selected sound to LockChime.wav at the root of the USB drive. The output must be under 1 MB.
en.车机上选择「玩具箱 → Boombox → 锁车音 → USB」。: On the vehicle, select Toybox → Boombox → Lock Sound → USB.
en.转换后的 WAV 必须小于 1 MB，请缩短音效或启用裁剪: The converted WAV must be smaller than 1 MB. Shorten the sound or enable trimming.
en.U 盘报告介质故障，请先检查文件系统: The USB drive reported a media error. Check its file system before writing.
en.U 盘尚未正常卸载，请先从主机安全卸载或检查文件系统: The USB drive was not cleanly unmounted. Safely unmount it from the host or check its file system.
en.U 盘锁车音回读不匹配，请检查 U 盘文件系统: The file read back from the USB drive differed. Check the USB file system.
en.何时写入锁车音？: When should the lock sound be written?
en.请停车后再立即写入。必要时会短暂强制弹出车机 U 盘。延迟写入会等待主机安全释放: Park before writing now. The vehicle USB drive may briefly eject. Delayed writes wait for the host to release it safely.
en.已排队，等待 U 盘安全空闲后写入: Queued. Waiting for the USB drive to become safe to write.
en.这段音效已不在待写入队列中: This sound is no longer queued.
en.主机仍在使用车机 U 盘，等待安全释放: The host is using the vehicle USB drive. Waiting for a safe release.
en.清空 F50 上已归档的哨兵、手动保存和行车记录录像？此操作不可撤销。: Clear all Sentry, manually saved, and dashcam recordings archived on the F50? This cannot be undone.
en.归档录像已为空: The recording archive is already empty
en.部分归档录像未能删除，请重试: Some archived recordings could not be deleted. Try again.
en.无法确认清空结果，请刷新录像资料库。: Could not confirm the result. Refresh the recording library.
